docs.title: Hi, I am Nasser Ali,
docs.text: An AI engineer specializing in operationalizing AI and building LLM-powered solutions. With a PhD in computer science focusing on authenticated data structures, I bring a deep understanding of formal methods such as abstract algebra and category theory to solve real-world problems. I value simplicity and strive to create impactful and elegant AI-driven solutions. Let's collaborate!

docs.title: 🎮 Services
docs.text:
Do you need help with operationalizing AI and large language models? I’m open to new consulting work.

I can help you if:

  • You need private and secure AI systems which run locally.
  • You want to apply elegant and flexible design to your LLM application.
  • You need to prove properties about your LLM application using formal methods.
  • You need to apply property-based-testing and metamorphic-testing to your LLM apps
  • You struggle to consistently enhance your LLM products.
  • Your LLMs apps are costing too much or running too slowly.
  • You feel overwhelmed by the complexity of tools and frameworks.

docs.title: Consulting
docs.text:
Consulting

Are you ready to build smarter, more reliable systems with the power of AI?

Using large language models (LLMs) effectively can be challenging. How do you ensure they fit into your systems seamlessly? How do you avoid costly mistakes in design, reliability, and scalability? These are the questions I help answer.

With years of experience, I apply proven methods like modular design techniques to create solutions that are reliable and tailored to your needs. Whether you’re developing critical systems like medical devices or refining LLMs for unique applications, I’ll work with you to build something that lasts.

Let’s work together to design AI systems you can count on. Get in touch today to start solving your toughest challenges.
